metadata.description: Minimal epoch-1 request accepted by the synchronous OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions provider seam. The request carries one model, ordered text messages, and an explicit non-streaming switch; provider-specific options are outside this contract.
Conversation messages in provider-visible order. The provider layer rejects an empty conversation before transport.
Always false for the synchronous epoch-1 seam; represented as the provider's JSON boolean rather than an invented string constant.
The text-only role vocabulary supported by epoch 1.
